concepts.def: Peak area ~ number of H atoms.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Alkyl R-CH3: 0.7-1.6 ppm. R-CH2-R: 1.2-1.4. R-OH: 1-5 (variable). R-CHO: 9-10. R-COOH: 11-12.

Aromatic ArH: 6.5-8 ppm. R-O-CH: 3.3-4.3. Cl/Br adjacent: 3-4 ppm.

n equivalent H neighbours -> peak split into n+1 lines (singlet, doublet, triplet, quartet).

Ethanol CH3CH2OH: CH3 (3H) split by 2 CH2 H -> triplet. CH2 (2H) split by 3 CH3 H -> quartet. OH (1H) usually broad singlet.

Each unique C gives one peak. C=O of acid/ester ~170 ppm; ketone/aldehyde ~190-205; aromatic C ~120-140; sp3 C 0-50.

Number of peaks = number of chemically distinct carbons. Symmetric molecules have fewer peaks.
